! Game text
| During a battle at opponent's site (or your non-<> site), instead of firing one of your character weapons at a target, cause that target to be immunity to attrition -3 (or limited to immunity to attrition < 5) for remainder of turn. OR Find one of your missing characters. OR Cancel a 'react.' OR Once per game, use 1 Force to exchange a card in hand with the top most character of ability < 5 in your Lost Pile. || —

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V) (Errata)]] shares the [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V)]] column; [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V) (Errata 2)]] shares the [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V)]] column; [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Found Someone You Have & Higher Ground (V)]] column.
